title: Guard skill
wikitext:
'''Guard''' skills are [[active skill]]s that provide defensive [[buff]]s for a short [[duration]]. Guard skills are all [[instant]] [[spell]]s.

==Mechanics==
Non-[[Vaal skill|Vaal]] Guard skills share a [[cooldown]]; they cannot be cast or [[trigger]]ed while another is on cooldown. Additionally, their cooldowns do not recover while any Guard buff is active. 

[[Vaal skill|Vaal]] Guard skills such as {{il|Vaal Molten Shell}} do not share the general Guard cooldown. They replace an existing Guard buff when used. 

Multiple different Guard buffs can be active at the same time if cooldowns allow, for example through {{il|Runegraft of Time}}.

{{Query keystone passive skills
|q_where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Guard %"

}}

|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
